_comment: The tracked source of truth for the viewer dashboard. outputs/ is gitignored and disposable; this file is not. Every viewer worth keeping has an entry here. Rebuild with: python3 scripts/viewers/viewerctl.py hub

groups.title: Dataset strata & sources
groups.blurb: What the model trains and evaluates on — one viewer per stratum, showing the clips as they actually are.

viewers.title: ctt_v2 corpora — refVFX + VFXMaster
viewers.blurb: Both external corpora along their counterfactual axes — same operator × many contents, same content × many operators. 153,758 samples, video read straight out of the WebDataset tars by byte range; nothing is extracted or copied.
viewers.notes: Static port of the app-server viewer on branch ctt-v2 (scripts/ctt_v2/dataset_viewer/, port 8799), verified at parity: identical sample counts, axis groups, group membership and row fields. The grouping serve.py did in memory is precomputed into range-addressable files; media URLs are range fetches into the shards. Page source is scripts/viewers/ctt_v2_corpora.html, linked in as index.html. Rebuild after data changes: python3 scripts/viewers/build_ctt_v2_corpora.py

viewers.title: EffectData — 3,061 effects + counterfactual axes
viewers.blurb: External candidate corpus (HF ysy31415926/EffectData, Apache-2.0): 132,850 videos across 3,061 effect classes. Browse every class at preview res with search + category facets; a second page shows the two CTT counterfactual axes — same operator × different endpoints, and same endpoints × different operator (shared source-id verified identical first frame, 0.99/255). Media served straight from the external staging dir via a symlink; nothing copied into the repo.
viewers.notes: Preview set = one clip/class (3,061, 845 MB) + annotations.json, staged at $LAB/data_external/EffectData (outside repo, re-downloadable from HF, ~822 GB full). Data JSONs built by scripts/viewers/effectdata_pipeline/{build_index,build_counterfactual,remote_zip}.py; remote_zip.py pulls single clips out of the per-effect zips via HTTP range (no full download). Counterfactual galleries = 137 clips in cf_media/. Assessed for CTT as an external S4/S5-style breadth stratum, not a cttv2 replacement.

viewers.title: S2 — procedural transition operators
viewers.blurb: The synthetic stratum of CTT v2: 7,990 clips from 42 shader operators. Landing page samples 42; browse walks every operator; retired shows the 420 blacklisted clips and why they went.

viewers.title: Luma-matte transitions — the map or the step()?

viewers.blurb: exp_077's D2 stratum: 252 ref/target pairs with filmstrips. Supersedes the D1 pilot.

viewers.title: HumanVid REAL (Pexels) — 60-clip sample

viewers.title: ladder2 — single reference of truth
viewers.blurb: The clean transition-eval campaign in one page: design, the seven seatbelts, leak-free prompt rendering, with inline examples. Authoritative over anything said in chat.

viewers.title: IC-LoRA trainings — results
viewers.blurb: Every IC-LoRA training and control on one toggleable page, any subset side by side over 139 identical inputs: the ladder2 generalist and ctt_v2 trainings, the base (no-adapter) and leaky-prompt levels, the refVFX externals, the bneck_coupling operator-token negative pair (matched vs shuffled code), and now the bneck_redesign 2x2 (HRC / V-JEPA x residual / raw) -- each arm a matched-vs-deranged-code pair read on paired delta-app_ref against the recalibrated bars 9/13, 8/13, P2 +0.10. HRC-residual landed first as a clean null (P2 -0.003, both cells short of bar); the other three arms join as they score. All columns come off ONE machine (DeltaAI, reference_v4 sha 459fd9a7, corpus dc2e139a); only the never-rescored specialists carry the stale223 badge.

mount._why: Generated by eval_ladder/viewer/build_runs.py into outputs/reports/iclora_runs/. The page emits repo-root-relative media paths prefixed with meta.rel, and this mount sits at the same depth, so the prefix resolves identically. See store/README.md for the contract.

viewers.title: IC-LoRA — neutral vs effect prompt
viewers.blurb: The prompt-symmetric fork of the IC-LoRA trainings page: the 4 arm families (base-prompt, base-cond, ic_gen, ctt_v2) each in BOTH prompt classes — neutral (no effect text) and effect-in-prompt — plus the refVFX externals, over 139 identical inputs on one machine (DeltaAI, reference_v4 459fd9a7). Adds ic_gen_effect (the missing adapter×text 2x2 cell) and the two V-neutral no-demo controls (the specificity zero anchor). Every neutral generation in a row shares one prompt and every effect generation shares one (validated, trigger token aside; refVFX excepted).

viewers.title: DCG flavor-(b) · target-dissolve null vs current null
viewers.blurb: Owner idea (b): use the TARGET's own endpoint-dissolve as the DCG null (no 2nd forward, ~half cost). 12 items × {CN, target-null const, target-null anneal} × w{1.25,1.5,3,6} × matched/swapped, champion store/runs/002. Judge: does target-null-anneal follow the operator as well as CN at equal/better quality + do matched/swapped diverge. Regen: scripts/viewers/gen_dcg_b.py

viewers.title: DCG-CN · blinded SxS confirmation (KEEP@w3)
viewers.blurb: Human confirmation of the automated KEEP verdict for the DCG-CN sampling arm. Per item: the demonstrated effect + 4 BLINDED candidates {baseline, matched-DCG w3, swapped-DCG w3, endpoint-only}, randomized; mark which performs the demonstrated transition class without quality collapse or demo copying. Key withheld (key.json). Instrument: matched attribution 12/12, robust to guard exclusion 9/9. Regen: scripts/viewers/gen_dcg_cn_sxs.py

viewers.blurb: Two inference-only tests on champion ctt_v3. Color sweep: green->red works (6/8), red->green fails (3/8) — order-dependent. Timing: NEGATIVE (beta 0.084) — the champion ignores demo pace. Regen: python3 misc/2026-08-14_timing_relay/build_viewer.py

viewers.title: Timing (RoPE) & control — Wave-3
viewers.blurb: Wave-3 on ctt_v3 vs ctt_v2. Demo PLACEMENT: champion FOLLOWS it (Δt50 -0.156, 18/18 sign-consistent) but v2 does NOT — better training buys demonstration-dependence. RoPE warp IMPOSES timing (γ=0.5 Δt50 -0.227 / γ=2.0 +0.19, 12/12, matches f^γ). Attribute control (animal/size) PASS; jump event-timing & RoPE uniform span-scale NEGATIVE. Includes an interactive BLIND placement panel you score yourself. Regen: python3 misc/2026-08-14_timing_relay/build_viewer_wave3.py

viewers.title: Lerp-collapse — endpoint-line shortcut (base vs trained LTX)
viewers.blurb: Does both-endpoint conditioning collapse a video flow model to a lerp? Explore every clip by ARM (raw LTX / CTT-v3 trained / same-rows start-only control) x CONDITIONING (both-endpoint / start-only) x CLASS (cut/dissolve/freeze/real), with per-clip DR (off-line residual) and M (tau mid-band). Result: raw both-endpoint collapses ~29% to a CUT (not a dissolve); training->0%. Campaign misc/2026-08-24_lerp_collapse (REPORT.md). Regen: scripts/viewers/build_lerp_collapse.py
viewers.notes: static page; clips.json + media symlinks + figures produced by the generator. misc/ campaign is git-untracked (durable on /taiga).

viewers.title: flowsig — matched vs deranged transition program (b_all & split)
viewers.blurb: Does LTX-2 follow an appearance-free 18-channel transition program? 13 grid rows (one per operator class) x {code_only MATCHED, code_only DERANGED (wrong-operator program), both MATCHED via per-token adaLN (b_all), both MATCHED via 1,280 RoPE-positioned tokens (split), NULL} x seeds 42/43, with the ground-truth target and both source demos shown as inputs. The comparison the page exists for is matched vs deranged: the ONLY difference is which demo the program came from. Arms runs/018 + runs/019 @10000 (recipe variant textdrop-coupled), store gens/022_flowsig_ball + gens/023_flowsig_split. QUALITATIVE - no bar attached. Campaign misc/2026-08-24_flow_signal_conditioning (DOSSIER.md). Regen: scripts/viewers/gen_flowsig_pilot.py
